# Labour market: labour-market (LABR)

Unemployment, participation, youth and female labour, and employment and output by sector. One row per labour market, keyed by LABOUR_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (table `<root>/macro/labour-market/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/labour-market.jsonl`, 185 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/labour-market.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `LABOUR_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LABOUR_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^LABR-` | `"LABR-AFG"` |
| `ECONOMY_NAME` | string | required | The country or territory the figures describe. | — | `"Afghanistan"` |
| `YEAR` | string | required | The year of the figures. | seen: `2025`, `2022`, `2023`, `2021` | `"2025"` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | number | required | The share of the labour force without work but available for and seeking employment. | unit: % of labour force | `13.351` |
| `PARTICIPATION` | number | required | The share of people aged 15 and over who work or look for work. | unit: % of population 15+ | `37.457` |
| `YOUTH_UNEMPLOYMENT` | number | required | The unemployment rate of 15 to 24 year-olds. | unit: % of youth labour force | `16.785` |
| `EMPLOYMENT_RATIO` | number | required | The share of people aged 15 and over who are employed. | unit: % of population 15+ | `32.457` |
| `FEMALE_PARTICIPATION` | number | required | The labour force participation rate of women aged 15 and over. | unit: % of women 15+ | `5.086` |
| `VULNERABLE` | number | required | Vulnerable employment (own-account and contributing family workers) as a share of total employment (World Bank). | unit: percent, in points | `81.7702` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT_PATH` | array of objects | required | The unemployment rate by year, one element per year: YEAR and RATE in % of the labour force (World Bank, ILO modelled estimate). | — | [11 objects] |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT_PATH[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT_PATH[].RATE` | number | required | The unemployment rate in that year. | unit: % of labour force | `9.032` |
| `BY_SECTOR` | array of objects | required | Jobs and output by sector, one element per sector (Agriculture, Industry, Services): EMPLOYMENT_SHARE in % of employment and VALUE_ADDED_SHARE in % of GDP. | — | [3 objects] |
| `BY_SECTOR[].SECTOR` | string | required | Agriculture, industry or services. | one of `Agriculture`, `Industry`, `Services` | `"Agriculture"` |
| `BY_SECTOR[].EMPLOYMENT_SHARE` | number | required | The sector's share of total employment. | unit: % of employment | `51.629` |
| `BY_SECTOR[].VALUE_ADDED_SHARE` | number | optional (filled in 98% of `BY_SECTOR[]` entries) | The sector's share of GDP (value added). | unit: % of GDP | `34.2931` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | required | The economy: an id of the economy kind (ECON-<ISO3>). | pattern `^ECON-`; links to `economy` | `"ECON-AFG"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Bank WDI), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation or organisations whose published data this view shows. | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse; attribution is required. | — | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The web page of the dataset. | — | `"https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-in…` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `_meta.licence` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The licence of the source data. | — | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 185 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `LABOUR_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `LABOUR_ID`, `ECONOMY_NAME`, `YEAR`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`, `PARTICIPATION`, `YOUTH_UNEMPLOYMENT`, `EMPLOYMENT_RATIO`, `FEMALE_PARTICIPATION`, `VULNERABLE`, `UNEMPLOYMENT_PATH`, `BY_SECTOR`, `ECONOMY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `LABOUR_ID` per snapshot.
- `LABOUR_ID` matches `^LABR-`.
